test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: India is an associate member of _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**SAFTA**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **South Asian Association **for **Regional Cooperation **has a **free trade agreement **called the **South Asian Free Trade Area **(SAFTA) (**SAARC**).
 
• The **SAARC Preferential Trading Arrangement **was replaced by the **agreement **when it **entered into force in 2006**.
 
• An **agreement **from **2004 **called the **South Asian Free Trade Area **established a **free-trade **zone with **1.6 billion inhabitants**.
 
• With the **aim of enhancing economic cooperation **and **integration**, it is between Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, the Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka.
 
• The **SAFTA's goal **is to **promote and elevate international **agreements for medium- and **long-term contracts**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **founding members **of **ASEAN**—**Indonesia**, **Malaysia**, the **Philippines**, **Singapore**, and **Thailand**—signed the **ASEAN Declaration **(also known as the Bangkok Declaration) on **August 8, 1967, **officially founding the **Association of Southeast Asian Nations or ASEAN**.
 
• **LAIA **the **1980 Montevideo Treaty **has established on **August 12th**, displacing the **Latin American Free Trade Association.**
 
• **NAFTA**, a **contentious trade agreement concluded in 1992**, eventually **removed the majority of tariffs **and other **trade restrictions on goods moving between the United States, Canada, and Mexico.**
